instructions: This is a WordPress multisite migration project for PHP 8.4 upgrade.
The core workflow is: audit → staging upgrade → test → production rollout → monitor.
Key directories: wp-content/themes/ (32 themes), wp-content/plugins/ (130+ plugins).
Critical config: multisite with path-based subdomains, Kadence Security hardened, getenv_docker() helper.
Never upgrade production directly — always use staging first.
Common pitfalls: hard-coded localhost:8080, wp_booster framework dependency, heavy plugin stack.
